statement: Arm cites large optimization gains on its platform, including an over 4x speedup for Qwen3-TTS on a vivo X300 phone.
why: Software optimization that multiplies throughput on existing silicon effectively adds usable inference capacity without new chips.

impact.mechanism: Better performance per unit of silicon means the same workload needs less hardware, easing effective compute scarcity at the margin.

evidence.excerpt: Qwen3-TTS achieved an over 4x speedup on a vivo X300 smartphone

confidence.basis: Vendor-reported benchmark on one device with no independent verification.

dispersion: Also cites over 40% improvement for Ultralytics YOLO26n using single-thread FP16 versus FP32.
